summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Blueprint Section Engine and extended Theme Engine. Backend: 10/10 functional tests pass (catalog, page CRUD, section add/update/delete/reorder/duplicate/reset, validation, palette presets, extended theme tokens). One known bug captured as xfail. Frontend: HomepageBuilderPage loads correctly, all critical testids present, Add modal exposes all 10 section types, viewport switching works, Save activates on dirty state, 8 brand presets visible including 'Editorial Noir' and 'Linear Mist'. All new CSS variables (--bp-display, --bp-h1, --bp-grain-intensity, --bp-glass-opacity, --bp-section-y) propagate via BlueprintContext.applyTheme. Italian locale active in sidebar (Lead/Progetti/Moodboard/Ispirazioni/Impostazioni).

minor.issue: ThemeUpdate Pydantic model in routers/settings.py omits 'atmosphere' and 'editorial' fields. PUTting {atmosphere:{grain_intensity:0.1}} silently drops the payload (returned effective.atmosphere.grain_intensity stays at default 0.04). Brand Studio palette-preset application that sends atmosphere overrides will be silently lost on the backend even though the preset selection succeeds visually.

integration_issues.issue: Live preview triggers /api/inspirations which returns 401 (4 console errors). The section renders empty silently — acceptable for empty tenant but causes noisy console errors.

action_items: MINOR FIX in /app/backend/routers/settings.py: add `atmosphere: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None` and `editorial: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None` to ThemeUpdate model so PUT /api/settings/theme can persist the new tokens. Currently they are accepted by the URL but silently dropped — Brand Studio's atmosphere overrides from 'Editorial Noir' / 'Linear Mist' presets will not survive a backend roundtrip.

OPTIONAL: investigate 401 from /api/inspirations when called from preview-frame (no Authorization header on iframe-less embedded fetch?). If MagazineGrid is rendered inside React without an iframe and uses fetch with credentials, ensure the Bearer token is attached.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeUpdate Pydantic model is the single bottleneck enforcing which top-level theme keys can be persisted. Since the theme engine has been extended with atmosphere/editorial, the model MUST be kept in sync or PUT becomes a silent no-op. Consider switching to `extra='allow'` Pydantic config or model_dump with raw dict to avoid future drift.

Section reorder endpoint is correct, but the reorder PATCH does not validate that body.order ids are unique — duplicate ids would silently produce one section per id (de-duplicated via dict). Low risk but worth a check + 400.

default_page() in section_registry.py generates new uuid section ids each call. Because get_page seeds in-memory on first read with _seed=true (not persisted), repeated GETs without PUT return different ids each time. This is acceptable but documented — clients must PUT before referencing ids.

rca of the issue: BUG RCA — atmosphere/editorial drop: /app/backend/routers/settings.py defines ThemeUpdate as a Pydantic BaseModel listing only palette, typography, shape, spacing, elevation, motion, components, assets, mode. The PUT handler does `body.model_dump(exclude_none=True)` so any field NOT declared in the model is dropped by Pydantic during validation before reaching the merge step. Repro: PUT /api/settings/theme {"atmosphere":{"grain_intensity":0.1}} → GET returns effective.atmosphere.grain_intensity=0.04 (default). Mitigation: add atmosphere + editorial Optional[Dict[str, Any]] fields to ThemeUpdate.
